techniques.name: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
techniques.procedure: 296 active phishing URLs targeting banking/financial services (46), gaming platforms — Roblox, Fortnite, PUBG (26), social media (Meta/Instagram, 13), streaming (Netflix, 9), e-commerce (Amazon, 5), and Microsoft services (5).

techniques.name: Link Target
techniques.procedure: Phishing infrastructure hosted on legitimate platforms: GitHub Pages (30), Vercel (10), Blogspot (4), GitBook (2), Weebly (2), and others (Framer, EdgeOne, Wasmer, Replit, Netlify, Cloudflare) — used to evade domain reputation blocklists.

techniques.name: Domains
techniques.procedure: Typosquatting and lookalike domains impersonating banking institutions, gaming platforms, and delivery services used as phishing landing pages.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
techniques.procedure: 3 active Emotet C2 IP addresses communicating over HTTP/HTTPS identified via Feodo Tracker. IPs 162.243.103.246 and 50.16.16.211 remain persistent across all collection cycles since May 4.
